readers.caption: Komputasi AI memerlukan pasokan listrik.
Menara pendingin membuang panas melalui aliran udara dan penguapan sebagian air.
Kabinet UPS membantu menjaga pasokan listrik. Infrastruktur pusat data mencakup peralatan pendukung selain server.
Susun tujuan dan konteks sebelum menulis permintaan. Foto kegiatan mencatat; tidak mendokumentasikan sesi AI tertentu.
Di kiri, pelatihan memperbarui bobot model melalui beberapa langkah berulang. Di kanan, inferensi memakai model terlatih untuk menghasilkan prediksi dari data baru.
Danau Sentarum, Kalimantan Barat, pada musim kemarau Agustus 2019. Kondisi air berubah menurut tempat dan musim; foto ini tidak menunjukkan dampak AI.
AI computing requires electricity.
A cooling tower releases heat through airflow and the evaporation of some water.
UPS cabinets help maintain electrical supply. Data center infrastructure includes supporting equipment alongside servers.
Plan your goal and context before writing a request. A note-taking photograph; it does not document a particular AI session.
On the left, training updates model weights through repeated steps. On the right, inference uses the trained model to predict from new data.
Lake Sentarum, West Kalimantan, in the August 2019 dry season. Water conditions vary by place and season; this photograph does not show an AI impact.
